summary: The proof is mathematically sound. The exact parity-class matching formula and saturation give the unique dominant vertex, star support, and identity for its selected mass. The clipped-loss estimate, partition algebra, and one-fiber common-slack construction yield the stated reduction and high-dispersion obstruction with the correct constants. Minimum support cardinality three excludes every negative antipodal two-direction family, which correctly implies pairwise intersection of the representation bodies; this in turn forces a selected nonsaturated fiber and gives the stated support-function width bound. The empty-set, singleton-class, zero-selected-mass, and threshold boundary cases are handled consistently.
